questions.text: A cube is built using 64 cubic blocks of side one unit. After it is built, one cubic block is removed from every corner of the cube. The resulting surface area of the body (in square units) after the removal is ________.
questions.solution:
The 4 [latex]\times[/latex] 4 [latex]\times[/latex] 4 cube has surface area 6 [latex]\times[/latex] 16 = 96.

Removing a corner block removes 3 outer unit faces but exposes 3 new unit faces inside the notch. So the area does not change.

Answer: 96

questions.text: If 'relftaga' means carefree, 'otaga' means careful and 'fertaga' means careless, which of the following could mean 'aftercare'?
questions.solution:
From the words: taga = care, and the modifier comes before taga: relf-taga = free + care (carefree), o-taga = ful + care, fer-taga = less + care.

In "aftercare", after comes before care in English, so in this code it comes after taga: taga + (after). Only "tagazen" has that form.

Answer: tagazen

questions.text:
Archimedes said, "Give me a lever long enough and a fulcrum on which to place it, and I will move the world."

The sentence above is an example of a ____________ statement.
questions.solution:
Archimedes did not literally plan to move the world; he used the image to show the power of a lever. That is a figurative statement.

Answer: figurative

questions.text: rewording of something written or spoken is a __________.
questions.solution:
A paraphrase restates something in different words. (Paradox = self-contradiction, paradigm = model, paraffin = a wax.)

Answer: paraphrase

questions.text: Out of the following four sentences, select the most suitable sentence with respect to grammar and usage.
questions.solution:
"Until" already carries the negative idea, so no "not" after it, and the singular subject "minister" needs "meets".

Answer: I will not leave the place until the minister meets me.
